comment: The section relies heavily on Section 3.7’s coverage measure, which counts realised reference elements. This is not sufficient to show whether deployed capabilities are operational, conformant, used, or effective.

public.text: The section relies heavily on Section 3.7’s coverage measure, which counts realised reference elements. This is not sufficient to show whether deployed capabilities are operational, conformant, used, or effective.
public.suggestedRevision: Distinguish model coverage, deployed coverage, conformant coverage, operational coverage, effective-use coverage, and population or geographic reach.
